mechanics.claim: Death's Hand fires five bolts in a cone over 0.25s; subsequent bolts against an enemy deal 25% bonus damage, meaning a target hit by all bolts takes up to double the initial bolt's damage.
mechanics.quote: unleashes five bolts of eldritch power over {{rutngt|0.25}} in a cone in the target direction that deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit. Subsequent bolts against an enemy deal 25% '''bonus''' damage.

mechanics.claim: The total damage to a single target is split evenly among each bolt that hits it, so hitting with more bolts deals less damage per bolt but more damage overall.
mechanics.quote: The total damage to a single target will be split evenly among each bolt that hits, meaning that hitting with more bolts will deal less damage per hit (but more overall damage).

mechanics.claim: The ability still casts and deals damage even if Swain dies during the cast time.
mechanics.quote: ''Death's Hand'' will still cast and deal damage if '''Swain''' dies during the cast time.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks all bolts of Death's Hand.
